body:
~Running this code will print a message on stdout (it can be easily reproduced running the tests)~

~Unicode parsing error, some characters were replaced with � (U+FFFD): Unexpected NUL character~

~This is due to [this](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/117546) issue.
Because this implementation is setting the line being hovered as the source code of the tokenizer, every time a line that start with a tab is hovered (e.g. all lines inside of a function definition) we get this message on the stdout.
I already tested the code of this PR with the [code of the PR that fixes the issue](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116986) and the message is not there anymore.
For this reason, this PR needs to be merged after #116986~

As suggested by @HolonProduction on Godot Contributors Chat, I changed the implementation to not use the Tokenizer anymore, so this comment doesn't apply anymore
